blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Senators on Wednesday questioned the abrupt cancellations of flights during bad weather, saying passengers should not have to travel for hours to the airport only to find out that their flights had been canceled. During a Senate committee on finance hearing on the 2027 spending plan of the Department of Science and Technology (DOST), Sen. Joel Villanueva recounted the experience of his friends from Bulacan who were supposed to take a 9 a.m. flight from Ninoy Aquino International Airport (Naia) Terminal 1 to Isabela.
